Subject: MAP & pricing — path to pilot close (CloudPlay)

Evan — attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and our current pricing worksheet so we can align on a go/no-go timeline for the pilot. Key asks here:

- Confirm the evaluation milestones (week 2 smoke test, week 4 KPI ramp) so we can bind the milestone discounts.
- Confirm target pilot start date (you mentioned early June).
- Any procurement / legal requirements we should fold into the MAP (PO terms, invoicing cadence, SOC2 evidence).

Proposed commercial structure (high level) is in Pricing_Worksheet_v3.xlsx:
- Pilot: 8 GPU-hours/day equivalent for 30 days (intro price on worksheet)
- Ramp threshold: >70% success on KPI set = 15% discount applied to committed months 2–6
- Commitment option: 6 month reserved capacity with staged ramp credits tied to MAP checkpoints

If you’re comfortable, Marissa can convert this into a clean SOW after we lock milestones. Requesting your confirmation by Fri so we can route for legal + procurement before month-end.

Attachments: [Attachment: CloudPlay_MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: Pricing_Worksheet_v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Thanks,

- Ramp cadence: can we make the KPI checkpoint at day 21 instead of week 4? That aligns with our internal release window.
